## Project Overview

The **SD4SP Project** focuses on the mechanisms of stratosphere-troposphere coupling. By analyzing planetary wave activity and the vertical propagation of zonal wind anomalies, we aim to improve predictability at sub-seasonal to seasonal scales.

### Theoretical Framework

The figure below summarizes the coupling processes analyzed in this project, focusing on the downward influence of Stratospheric Sudden Warming (SSW) events.

![**Figure 1:** Conceptual model of the coupling between the polar vortex and tropospheric circulation.](../assets/images/sd4sp-figure.png){width="80%" fig-align="center"}
